text: BP appointed Ian Tyler chair after serving as interim chair since May 26 following Albert Manifold's removal. Senior independent director Amanda Blanc will leave the board after a successor is appointed. Meg O'Neill remains CEO, BP's fourth in six years.

meta.note: Blanc's departure is announced but remains contingent on appointment of a successor.

text: The 10-year Treasury yield reached 4.814%, its highest level since November 2023. The 30-year traded at 5.262% and the 2-year at 4.383%. Medium- and long-term government yields remain elevated across global sovereign debt markets.

meta.note: This extends the same yield structure logged Sept. 1 to a new 10-year multiyear high.

text: Chevron was assigned two additional Orinoco Belt oilfields and committed $7B to its Venezuela operations. Current production is about 280,000 bpd, with 600,000 bpd designated for 2031. Operations remain structured through joint ventures with PDVSA.

meta.note: The 600,000-bpd figure is a stated production target rather than current operating capacity.

text: Berkshire added $17B of Alphabet shares in Q2, making Alphabet its third-largest equity holding. Berkshire owns about 106M Class A and C shares, valued near $36.6B. An initial $10B position was established 15 months earlier.

meta.note: The event concerns Berkshire's portfolio structure; Abel's AI characterization is contextual rather than classificatory.

text: More than 17M barrels of oil transited Hormuz by ship Monday, according to the U.S. Energy Secretary. A U.S.-protected corridor along Oman carries Gulf tanker traffic, while Iran demands use of a northern route. At least two tankers were attacked this week.

meta.note: U.S. transit estimates exceed independent ship-tracking figures, leaving measurement variance unresolved.

text: U.S. private payrolls increased 38,000 in August, the smallest gain since January. Education and health added 45,000 jobs, while several sectors contracted. Firms with 500+ workers added 34,000 positions; firms with fewer than 50 added 3,000.

meta.note: Sector gains exceed the net total because employment contracted across multiple other categories.
